title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Fee Schedule — Late Fee, Late Payment Charge and Grace Days
content:
Ridgeline Pro Credit charges lateness in two different ways according to the kind of account. A revolving account (Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge or Pro Revolving Charge Plus) carries a flat late fee on a statement whose minimum was not paid by the due date. A pay-in-full account (any Ridgeline Commercial Account tier) carries a monthly late payment charge on its past-due invoice balance.

| Tier | Late fee (USD) | Monthly late payment charge (percent per month) | Minimum late payment charge (USD) | Late charge grace days (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge | 39.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Pro Revolving Charge Plus | 49.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 | 0.00 | 2.00 | 2.00 | 0 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 30 Select | 0.00 | 1.75 | 2.00 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 45 | 0.00 | 1.50 | 5.00 | 5 |
| Ridgeline Commercial Account Net 60 Enterprise | 0.00 | 1.50 | 5.00 | 10 |

## Terms used in the schedule

- **Late fee**: the flat fee on a revolving statement. It is 0.00 on every pay-in-full tier.
- **Monthly late payment charge**: the percentage per month on the past-due invoice balance of a pay-in-full account. It is 0.00 on both revolving tiers.
- **Minimum late payment charge**: the lowest late payment charge on a statement that has a past-due invoice balance.
- **Late charge grace days**: the calendar days after an invoice's due date before it counts as past due for the late payment charge. On the Commercial Account Net 30 Select, for instance, an invoice is not counted as past due for the charge until 5 calendar days after its due date have passed.

## Points of reading

- The schedule gives one figure per tier; an account is charged at the figures of its own tier, as shown on the account.
- The two revolving tiers differ in the late fee only (39.00 against 49.00).
- Among the pay-in-full tiers the Net 45 and the Net 60 Enterprise share a monthly percentage of 1.50 and a minimum of 5.00, and differ in grace days (5 against 10).
